# Sales Development Representative

[New York](https://startup.jobs/locations/new-york), [U.S.](https://startup.jobs/locations/united-states)

[Full-Time](https://startup.jobs/full-time-jobs)

[On-site](https://startup.jobs/)

This job is no longer available and isn't accepting applications.

At Bitly, we believe in the power of the link or scan - to start a conversation, build a relationship or grow a business. Our mission is to turn every interaction into a catalyst for connections. It’s what motivates us to help people share, promote and engage everywhere on the Internet. We do this by being relentlessly product-focused, fostering the free-flowing exchange of ideas, and inspiring people around the world to dream up new ways of using Bitly.

## The Role

As a Sales Development Representative, you’ll be part of one of the most important parts of the Sales process at Bitly: creating a vision of success and optimized outcomes for customers.

As part of the job, you will be uncovering business needs from prospective customers and presenting them with relevant Bitly solutions to generate pipeline for the Sales team. You’ll become an expert in all things Bitly, contributing to the growth and scale of our paid customer base globally.

This role owns a process that is crucial to Bitly’s business, delivering a seamless bridge between our prospects and our sales team. You’ll be speaking with executives from Fortune 1000 companies and businesses around the world and should be comfortable making first contact and building knowledge-based product value from limited information. This individual’s primary focus will be on conversion of our robust inbound funnel, initiating conversations with key decision-makers and qualifying opportunities for the team.

If you’re curious, detail oriented, metrics driven, and eager to learn, this is the right Sales role for you!

## What You'll Do

- Qualify a large volume of Inbound leads (via phone and email) from global, prospective companies for handoff to Account Executives
- Ask open-ended questions to prospects that uncover pain points and business needsEffectively convey the value of Bitly through pitching with passion
- Successfully manage and overcome prospect objections, proposing relevant solutions that fulfill prospect’s needs
- Collaborate with the wider sales and customer success teams to convert your prospects into sales-accepted opportunities and future clients.
- Generate a healthy pipeline and maintain all stages of the pre-sales lead pipeline in Salesforce and Salesloft
- Consistently achieve and exceed qualified opportunity quotasEnsure an excellent customer journey for our prospective customers, from inquiry to meeting with an Account Executive
- Become a trusted resource, developing superior relationships with prospects

## Who You Are

- 1 - 2 years SaaS experience in a customer-facing role, ideally new client development, customer acquisition, or customer conversion
- Highly self motivated individual with a positive attitude and strong passion to work in Sales
- Experience in a high energy, Sales environment that required phone/email outreach and analyzed performance by measured results
- Excellent listening and communication skills - both verbal and written
- Familiarity with Salesforce or comparable customer relationship management tools
- Bonus: Experience with Salesloft, Salesforce, and Calendly!

## Our Values

- **Customer First.** We are fiercely committed to our customers' success. Our Job is to ensure that our trusted platform, performance, and people help customers achieve their goals
- **Growth Focused.** We are building a fast growing, healthy business powered by quick learning, constant optimization, and data driven decisions
- **R.E.S.P.E.C.T.** We are a team that respects each other and values diversity and inclusion. We treat others as we’d want to be treated and uphold the highest levels of integrity in everything we do
- **>(!=) Greater than, not equal to.** We are driven to win, bring our “A Game” to work each day and deliver exceptional results
- **Do or Do Not, There is No Try.** We say what we are going to do and we do it

## Employee Benefits

- Competitive Salary + Stock Options
- Comprehensive and competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance (all LGBT friendly)
- 401k with up to 4% employer match
- One Medical membership: Doctors you can text, call or email 24/7 and receive access to expert insurance guidance where available
- Wellness reimbursement program
- Partial cell phone service reimbursement
- Voluntary LegalShield for legal services and IDShield for identity theft protection
- Unlimited vacation, personal time, and flexible work from home policies
- Full support for remote work during COVID-19, including a home office and separate WiFi stipend
- Generous parental leave policies; maternity and parental leave for growing families
- Budget for professional development opportunities, including courses and conference attendance
- Company sponsored volunteering opportunities (when it is safe to do so)

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” Bitly also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Bitly.
